summary: Iter61 RETEST of the GO-TO-DASHBOARD handoff on /upload PrecisionScanOverlay (data-testid='wait-go-dashboard-btn'). Iteration 60's HIGH bug is FIXED. Repro'd the full flow (login as testfree-mar@elitescout.com, transcoded webm upload, ScoutMode 3-tap confirms + scout-finish-early, form fill, submit). Waited for wait-live-pct to exceed 15% (reached 23% within 1s), then clicked wait-go-dashboard-btn. Every expected behavior fires: success toast "We'll let you know when your report is ready.", immediate navigate to /dashboard, bg-analysis-tracker pill visible +1s later, localStorage.elite_token survives the click, localStorage.scoutmeplay.activeAnalysis is written with the report id, and /api/reports/{id}/status polling continues from the tracker with 200 responses (zero 401s). The 'Your scout report is ready!' toast + tracker-disappearance was NOT observed within the 6-min watch window because the surrogate webm analysis was still on Step 2/5 (Preparing your video) — environmental (headless-Chromium webm), NOT a code regression. The tracker was live and correctly polling the whole time. All handoff wiring is correct end-to-end.

verifications.ready_toast_note: Analysis still on Step 2/5 at end of 6-min watch window; not tested to completion — environmental webm-surrogate limitation from iter60, NOT a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: UploadPage.jsx line 593-607 (onContinueInBackground) — clean, correct immediate-handoff. startBackgroundAnalysis(rid) is called before setSubmitting(false) + navigate('/dashboard'), guaranteeing the tracker owns the report id before the overlay unmounts. Iter60 bug fully resolved.

UploadPage.jsx line 466-473 (poll loop backgrounded branch) — now correctly a no-op-after-handoff: just re-arms startBackgroundAnalysis and returns. Correct defensive design in case the click lands mid-upload before reportIdRef is set (the button handler covers the no-id path with a friendlier toast).

BackgroundAnalysisTracker.jsx line 132-136 — correctly hides the pill on /upload and only renders when status==='analyzing'. Verified live: pill appears +1s after navigating to /dashboard once the first poll returns status='analyzing'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the requested retest — all 5 expected behaviors observed; ready-toast completion left unverified due to same environmental webm slowness noted in iter60

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter60 HIGH bug on wait-go-dashboard-btn is fixed. If iter62 needs to confirm the 'ready' toast + tracker-disappearance transition on real hardware, use a shorter/simpler test video or bump the wait window to ~10 min — the analysis pipeline was still on Step 2/5 (Preparing) after 6 min on the webm surrogate used here.
rca_of_the_issue: iter60 root cause was that onContinueInBackground only set backgroundedRef.current=true and relied on the next poll-loop tick to call navigate('/dashboard'); on the loop's next tick, startBackgroundAnalysis(data.id) was invoked from a poll-loop tick that had already lost the httpOnly-cookie context (or was silently throwing), so navigate() never fired and subsequent status polls 401'd. FIX (verified in iter61): the button handler now performs the full handoff IMMEDIATELY — startBackgroundAnalysis(reportIdRef.current) + success toast + setSubmitting(false) + navigate('/dashboard') — and the poll-loop branch is reduced to a defensive re-arm + return. Verified live: navigation is instant, tracker owns the report and polls 200s from the dashboard, and localStorage.elite_token is preserved throughout.
